zh:
让数据在生产系统中保持正确、及时、可回溯、有权限边界。理解 CDC、Lakehouse、SQL、Spark 与 Text-to-SQL 的集成决策。

11.1 端到端数据路径：从源事件到可信 AI Context

FDE 不该只讨论 RAG 检索策略，还要确认：数据是谁提供的、更新有多快、何时可以查询、出了错是否能重放，以及租户权限在哪里执行。

Source DB / SaaS / events
    ↓ CDC / batch extract
Bronze · raw append + offsets
    ↓ schema / dedup / quarantine
Silver · verified, versioned entities
    ↓ contracts / temporal joins
Gold · governed customer views
    ├── SQL, BI and workflow queries
    ├── model features
    └── retrieval indexing → RAG
边界必须明确的约束常见失败
Capture事件序列、offset、delete漏更或重复
Normalize唯一键、schema、时区跨系统错配
Consumefreshness、租户、可追溯过期或越权读取
工程结论

实时 Agent + 错误的数据 = 快速出错。数据正确性、及时性与授权是不同的验证维度。

11.2 ETL / ELT / CDC：选最适合数据边界的路径

机制适用情况要验证的问题
ETL先清洗/限制敏感数据再入库前置逻辑能否重放？
ELT先安全留存原始数据，再在仓内转换原始数据访问是否隔离？
CDC增量变更与删除传播初始快照、顺序、offset 与 tombstone

Batch 与 Streaming 取决于消费者对事件可见延迟的目标，而不是“实时”是否听起来更先进。

11.3 Idempotency：允许消息重复，不允许业务结果重复

event(source, event_id, entity, version, operation)
 → durable raw log
 → validate + quarantine
 → dedup(source, event_id)
 → merge if version is newer
 → atomically commit sink and checkpoint

At-least-once delivery 不是异常，而是工程约束。必须明确谁生成稳定的幂等键、何时重试、如何处理 out-of-order 更新与删除，以及跨系统写入如何补偿。

11.4 Lakehouse / Delta：Bronze、Silver、Gold 各自负责什么

层职责不可误认为
Bronze可重放原始数据、provenance原始数据可信
Silver校验、去重、更新、实体标准化业务含义已经统一
Gold业务契约与消费者视图自动解决跨系统事务

Delta transaction log 提供表层面的快照和原子提交；它本身不能保证 HTTP、消息队列、其他数据库之间的 exactly-once 业务效果。

11.5 SQL Window 与 SCD2：保留时序真实性

WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
    PARTITION BY tenant_id, entity_id
    ORDER BY source_version DESC, ingested_at DESC
  ) AS rn
  FROM normalized_events
)
SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1;

最新记录查询必须定义版本比较、并列消解、删除语义。SCD Type 2 使用 effective_from / effective_to 维护历史快照；point-in-time join 避免训练时偷看未来。

11.6 Spark / Streaming：先看执行计划与状态边界

症状排查入口权衡
Join 很慢Explain、shuffle bytes、skewBroadcast 对小表有效，过大会 OOM
任务尾部很长Task skew、spill、文件数分区数量不是越多越好
Streaming state 变大Event-time、watermark、checkpoint迟到数据策略与完整性权衡

11.7 Text-to-SQL：能执行 ≠ 有权限

User intent
 → approved semantic schema + identity
 → SQL candidate
 → parse / allowlisted operations
 → database RLS / scoped credentials
 → EXPLAIN / row and time budget
 → run / verify / return source freshness

LLM 生成一个 SELECT 不等于安全。权限应由数据库策略或可信服务执行；解析、只读角色、超时、成本预算及结果验证都是独立关卡。

11.8 订单状态错乱：用可复现的证据交付

客户发现订单在快递交接前显示“已签收”。第一步不是微调 LLM，而是核对来源事件时间、序列、重复、删除和最终状态定义；再用 golden timeline 验证事实还原。

验收指标意义
CDC lag p95变更到可查询的延迟
Duplicate-effect rate重复消息导致重复业务影响的比例
Reconciliation completeness源系统与目标结果可核对
Policy-leak tests跨租户请求无法取数

Databricks Data & SQL：CDC、Spark、Streaming、权限与指标语义

INDEPENDENT FDE RESEARCH

题目由公开 FDE 考点独立扩展，不是会员标准答案。示例阈值和架构是教学设计；供应商事实以链接的官方文档为准。

数据工程面试不是背几个 Spark API。要能解释：同一数据如何被重复消费、如何按业务次序还原、SQL 为什么结果错误、权限是否真正由存储层执行。

Q17 · AUTO CDC 和 MERGE 在乱序事件中怎么选？

Lakeflow 的 AUTO CDC 基于 SEQUENCE BY 排序，支持 Type 1/2 与 delete；通常优先用它处理满足约束的 CDC 流。自定义 MERGE 需要自己负责顺序、幂等、删除和历史。不能把两个独立来源的 version 任意互相比较。

CREATE OR REFRESH STREAMING TABLE order_status_history;
CREATE FLOW apply_order_cdc AS AUTO CDC INTO order_status_history
FROM stream(ops.silver.order_changes)
KEYS (tenant_id, order_id)
APPLY AS DELETE WHEN operation = 'DELETE'
SEQUENCE BY source_sequence
COLUMNS * EXCEPT (operation, source_sequence)
STORED AS SCD TYPE 2;
工程边界

这是有前提的 Lakeflow Pipeline 教学 SQL；需要合法源表、支持的 Runtime/Edition 和每个主键有效的排序键，不是本地 Spark SQL 命令。

Q18 · Delta CDF 能保证 30 天历史回放吗？

不能。CDF 要先启用，只包含启用后的变更且受到保留窗口限制。历史快照的切点、后续 source offset、归档策略和重放后的业务对账都需要定义。

Q19 · Spark Join 很慢，先看什么？

症状诊断
长尾 Task热点 Key / AQE Skew / Spill
Shuffle 巨大Join keys（含 Tenant）/ 广播可行性
结果行数膨胀一对多 Join 误写、唯一键失效
小文件太多扫描调度与 Compaction
orders = spark.table('ops.gold.orders')
customers = spark.table('ops.gold.customers')
joined = orders.join(customers, ['tenant_id','customer_id'], 'left')
joined.explain('formatted')

Q20 · Watermark 会自动删除所有旧数据吗？

不会。它表示对事件时间迟到数据的容忍界限，在特定 Stateful Operator 下帮助清理旧状态；不会替代 Checkpoint，也不保证所有迟到事件都被处理。阈值应根据真实延迟分布和损失风险制定。

Q21 · SQL 跑得快但结果错，怎么分析？

MAX(event_time) 只能求最大时间，不能保证得到正确订单状态。检查来源权限、Source Version、Tombstone、时间语义、SCD2 Point-in-Time Join 和 Join Cardinality。

Q22 · Unity Catalog Row Filters 是否已足够保证 Text-to-SQL 安全？

不够。还需要身份可信、对象级 GRANT、SQL 限制、行列权限、审计和结果限制。ABAC 可在更高层级集中应用受控标签规则，但有计算版本和冲突限制；不要假设用共享服务账号查询会自动使用最终用户身份。

Q23 · “迟交率”应该让 LLM 自动定义吗？

不能。业务负责人必须确认分子、分母、时区、取消订单处理和记录版本。用 Metric View/Semantic Contract 统一定义，再用 Golden SQL Case 对比，避免同一概念在 Dashboard 和 Agent 中计算不同。

一手来源: Lakeflow AUTO CDC · Delta CDF · ABAC requirements · Metric views · Spark tuning
en:
Keep production data correct, fresh, traceable and permission-aware. Learn CDC, Lakehouse, SQL, Spark and Text-to-SQL as one delivery discipline.

11.1 End-to-end data path: source events to trusted AI context

An FDE must inspect the data plane behind RAG: source ownership, freshness, query readiness, replayability, and enforcement of tenant permissions.

Source DB / SaaS / events
    ↓ CDC / batch extract
Bronze · raw append + offsets
    ↓ schema / dedup / quarantine
Silver · verified, versioned entities
    ↓ contracts / temporal joins
Gold · governed customer views
    ├── SQL, BI and workflow queries
    ├── model features
    └── retrieval indexing → RAG
BoundaryExplicit contractFailure
CaptureSequence, offset, deleteMissed or duplicate events
NormalizeUnique key, schema, time zoneCross-system mismatch
ConsumeFreshness, tenancy, lineageStale or unauthorized reads
Engineering rule

A fast agent with incorrect data fails faster. Correctness, freshness, and authorization are independent test dimensions.

11.2 ETL / ELT / CDC: choose by data boundary

MechanismWhen usefulVerify
ETLTransform before governed loadCan transforms be replayed?
ELTGoverned raw landing; warehouse transformsIs raw access isolated?
CDCRow-level changes and deletesSnapshot, order, offset, tombstone

Batch versus streaming is driven by the consumer's visibility-lag objective, not by which architecture sounds more advanced.

11.3 Idempotency: duplicated events must not duplicate effects

event(source, event_id, entity, version, operation)
 → durable raw log
 → validate + quarantine
 → dedup(source, event_id)
 → merge if version is newer
 → atomically commit sink and checkpoint

At-least-once delivery is an engineering constraint. Define who owns stable idempotency keys, retries, out-of-order updates, deletes, and cross-system reconciliation.

11.4 Lakehouse / Delta: Bronze, Silver, Gold ownership

LayerResponsibilityNot a guarantee of
BronzeReplayable raw data and provenanceRaw data is trustworthy
SilverValidated, deduplicated, upserted entitiesBusiness meaning is agreed
GoldConsumer contracts and business viewsCross-system atomicity

A Delta transaction log gives table-level snapshot and atomic-commit behavior; it does not guarantee exactly-once business effects across HTTP, queues, and other databases.

11.5 SQL windows and SCD2: preserve temporal truth

WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
    PARTITION BY tenant_id, entity_id
    ORDER BY source_version DESC, ingested_at DESC
  ) AS rn
  FROM normalized_events
)
SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1;

Latest-record queries need version precedence, tie breaking and delete semantics. SCD Type 2 preserves effective-time intervals; point-in-time joins prevent training-time future leakage.

11.6 Spark / streaming: inspect the plan and state boundaries

SymptomInspectTrade-off
Slow joinExplain, shuffle bytes, skewBroadcast small tables; oversized joins risk OOM
Long-tail tasksTask skew, spill, file countMore partitions are not always better
Growing stream stateEvent-time, watermark, checkpointLate-data policy versus completeness

11.7 Text-to-SQL: executable does not mean authorized

User intent
 → approved semantic schema + identity
 → SQL candidate
 → parse / allowlisted operations
 → database RLS / scoped credentials
 → EXPLAIN / row and time budget
 → run / verify / return source freshness

An LLM-generated SELECT is not a safety guarantee. Enforce permissions in the database or a trusted service, with parsing, read-only roles, budgets and result verification as separate gates.

11.8 Order-status incidents: deliver reproducible evidence

If an order appears delivered before handoff, audit event times, sequences, duplicates, deletes and canonical state semantics before touching the LLM. Validate reconstructed timelines with labeled historical cases.

Acceptance indicatorMeaning
CDC lag p95Delay from source change to query
Duplicate-effect rateRate of duplicated business effects
Reconciliation completenessSource and target totals reconcile
Policy-leak testsCross-tenant reads are blocked

Databricks data and SQL: CDC, Spark, streaming, governance and semantic metrics

INDEPENDENT FDE RESEARCH

Questions are independently written from public FDE topics, not paid-site answers. Example thresholds and architecture are teaching choices; provider facts refer to the linked primary docs.

Data engineering interviews ask more than Spark APIs. Explain event replay, business ordering, SQL correctness and whether storage policies truly enforce user authorization.

Q17 · When do you choose AUTO CDC over MERGE for out-of-order changes?

Lakeflow AUTO CDC orders changes by SEQUENCE BY, with Type 1/2 and deletion logic. It is a fit when the source sequencing contract qualifies. Custom MERGE requires self-managed ordering, idempotency, deletes and history. Versions from independent sources are not automatically comparable.

CREATE OR REFRESH STREAMING TABLE order_status_history;
CREATE FLOW apply_order_cdc AS AUTO CDC INTO order_status_history
FROM stream(ops.silver.order_changes)
KEYS (tenant_id, order_id)
APPLY AS DELETE WHEN operation = 'DELETE'
SEQUENCE BY source_sequence
COLUMNS * EXCEPT (operation, source_sequence)
STORED AS SCD TYPE 2;
Engineering boundary

This is conditional Lakeflow pipeline SQL. It requires valid source streams, supported runtime/edition and per-key sequence semantics; it is not standalone Spark SQL.

Q18 · Does Delta CDF guarantee a 30-day replay?

No. CDF is opt-in, captures subsequent changes only and follows retention. Specify consistent snapshot cutover, source offsets, archive policy and post-replay reconciliation.

Q19 · What should you inspect first when Spark joins are slow?

SymptomDiagnostic
StragglerHot keys / AQE skew / spill
Huge shuffleJoin keys incl. tenant / broadcast feasibility
Row explosionUnintended many-to-many join, broken uniqueness
Many small filesScheduling overhead and compaction
orders = spark.table('ops.gold.orders')
customers = spark.table('ops.gold.customers')
joined = orders.join(customers, ['tenant_id','customer_id'], 'left')
joined.explain('formatted')

Q20 · Does a watermark automatically delete all old data?

No. A watermark sets an event-time lateness tolerance and bounds state in applicable operators. It neither replaces checkpoints nor guarantees inclusion of every late event. Choose it from observed lateness and risk.

Q21 · How do you debug fast SQL that returns wrong business results?

MAX(event_time) only selects a timestamp, not the correct order state. Inspect source authority, versioning, tombstones, temporal semantics, SCD2 point-in-time joins and join cardinality.

Q22 · Are Unity Catalog row filters sufficient for safe Text-to-SQL?

Not alone. You also need trusted identity, object GRANT, SQL policy, row/column enforcement, audit and result budgets. ABAC adds centrally governed tag policies with compute/conflict limitations; a shared service principal does not automatically inherit end-user scope.

Q23 · Should the LLM invent the meaning of late-shipment rate?

No. Owners must approve numerator, denominator, time zone, cancellations and revision. Use metric views/semantic contracts with golden SQL cases to prevent dashboard-agent disagreements.
